rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who works on or sails a boat.

example.english: Ming is a sailor who goes out to sea every day.
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai6 seoi2 sau2 seng4 jat6 ceot1 hoi2

rows.note: A speaker picks this formal term when referring specifically to a professional seafarer or ship’s crew member.

example.english: They are a sailor who has worked aboard cargo ships for many years.
example.traditional: 佢係一名海員，長年喺貨船上工作。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 ming4 hoi2 jyun4 coeng4 nin4 hai2 fo3 syun4 soeng6 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this for someone who sails a sailing boat as a sport or recreational activity rather than as ship’s crew.

example.english: They are a sailor who competes for Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 佢係帆船運動員，代表香港參加比賽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 faan4 syun4 wan6 dung6 jyun4 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3
